title: Commit or tag pushed by a workflow with GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger the next workflow
symptoms: A release or deploy workflow on push or tags never starts after a bot commit
A pull request opened by a workflow shows checks waiting for approval
Manual pushes of the same change trigger normally
cause: Events caused by GITHUB_TOKEN do not start new workflow runs, to prevent loops. workflow_dispatch and repository_dispatch are the exceptions, and pull requests it opens now create runs that need approval from a user with write access.
fix: Push with a GitHub App installation token or a fine grained PAT, or chain the next workflow with workflow_dispatch or workflow_run.
affected: GitHub Actions on github.com, as of October 2026
